round1Resolutions.evidence: The new check_record rule refuses all seven round-1 probes (a)-(g) when re-run against candidate 2 ('entrypoint type labels a file other than its subject's executable' / 'interpreter type outside the interpreted closures'). An ordinary gate library in its own type is still accepted. N103-N110 pin these. findings.location: scripts/native_qualification_v4.py check_record, the in-set census block (entry_files lookup and interpreter_labels test); README 'Entrypoints and labels' ('So a record cannot declare a second entry file for any domain') and the P-b in-set/out-of-set split
findings.finding: The in-set census looks up and compares whole selinuxLabel strings, but SELinux grants entrypoint (and EXECUTE for the interpreter type) by type alone. `files[].selinuxLabel` is a free printable string in the schema, and `backendFiles[].selinuxLabel` allows system_r or object_r. So the same type under another context spelling passes, and the record still declares a second entry file for a LABEL_BOUND or ENTRY_BOUND domain. That is the hole N1-1 was meant to close. The rule claims to hold the census's in-set half, while T04-ENTRYPOINT-CENSUS keeps only the out-of-set half, so nothing covers these. Reviewer probes, with every capture rebound to the mutated record (check_record and check_qualification both None, so accepted): a gate library 'unconfined_u:object_r:planeon_broker_exec_t:s0'; a gate library 'system_u:object_r:planeon_broker_exec_t:s0:c0'; a worker data file 'system_u:system_r:planeon_worker_exec_t:s0'; a kubelet library 'system_u:system_r:qualk8s_scheduler_exec_t:s0', which the backend file pattern itself admits; a containment library 'system_u:object_r:planeon_broker_exec_t:s0-s0'; and a gate library 'system_u:object_r:planeon_interpreter_exec_t:s0:c1'. The exact-constant spelling of each is refused.
findings.requiredChange: Make the in-set census type-based. Either (a) in check_record, require every enrolled file label (files and backendFiles) to be a well-formed context and compare its type field (the third ':' field) with the types of the entrypoint constants and of interpreterLabel, in both halves of the rule; or (b) constrain both inventories' selinuxLabel in the schema to the canonical 'system_u:object_r:<type>:s0' form, so that string equality is type equality (this changes the schema digest and edge row). Add negatives for the user, role and level variants (a planeon file, a backend file, and the interpreter type). Keep the README's 'cannot declare a second entry file' sentence only once it is true.

findings.finding: The in-set census only knows the exec types of the backend components present in the record. Under v4's schema the only backend profile is the eight-component unit-distribution fixture (componentKeys const), so qualk8s_proxy_exec_t and qualk8s_netpol_exec_t are always covered today. A successor that admits a six-component profile would leave those two types uncovered.
findings.requiredChange: Carry to the packet review or the W02-PROD successor: build the set of exec types from all eight component constants, not from the components present.

optionalItemWeighed.item: N1-1 optional part: refuse matrix v5's other ENTRYPOINT types (planeon_maint_exec_t, qualk8s_container_file_t) on enrolled files
optionalItemWeighed.position: not required in this contract; keeping it as an open item is right
optionalItemWeighed.reason: v4's LABEL_BOUND and ENTRY_BOUND claims cover only captured domains. planeon_maint_t is entered only when planeon_maintenance_mode is 1, and the record pins it to 0 (schema const; the boolean equalities are kept as OUT_OF_SCOPE_HOST/T04). qualk8s_container_t (pods) is no capture target. A reviewer probe confirms both labels are accepted today; neither weakens a claim v4 makes. Refusing them would need the model to carry matrix types beyond the subjects' own constants, which the design keeps out (no matrix pin, D1-13). That belongs with the layer validator's matrix cross-check, or with a successor that captures those domains. N2-1's type-based comparison is required either way.
